Method of Attack: Acts as a malicious HID device (keyboard and mouse) to input commands remotely via WiFi
Simulates user interaction to prevent session lock by inactivity timer
Allows remote execution of commands and mouse manipulation
Can be preconfigured to connect to WiFi networks and open reverse shells
Potential for WiFi deauthentication attacks using spoofed MAC addresses
Attack Vector: Malicious USB cable detected as HID device when plugged in
Remote WiFi connection to the cable's embedded WiFi chip
Physical USB connection combined with remote WiFi access
